issues.description: The problem statement (UML) specifies Pneumatic.raisePressure(int), but the solution's Pneumatic interface declares raisePressure(double). The solution's implementing classes (LaunchedDropdownTower and LaunchedRollerCoaster) implement raisePressure(int). This mismatch between the interface and its implementations (and with the UML) will cause compilation errors and confuses students about the correct parameter type.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the parameter type across all artifacts. Preferably change the Pneumatic interface method signature in src/de/tum/in/ase/Pneumatic.java from raisePressure(double) to raisePressure(int) to match the UML/problem statement and the implementing classes; alternatively, update the UML/problem statement and the implementing classes to use double if that was intended.
